NEURALINK JUST MADE A MAJOR SURGERY BREAKTHROUGH
Neuralink has updated its surgical procedure and completely removed a key step.
Instead of removing the dura (the tough protective membrane around the brain), the implant threads now go directly through the dura without needing to take it out.
This change makes the surgery:
•  Less invasive
•  Faster
•  Safer
•  Much easier to scale to more patients

CYBERCAB: FROM TESTING TO MILLIONS ON THE ROAD
Tesla is currently deep in testing the Cybercab p— a purpose-built robotaxi with no steering wheel or pedals.

The long-term goal is massive scale: millions of these vehicles operating autonomously in cities around the world.

At an estimated cost of around $0.20 per mile, Cybercab could make ride-hailing far cheaper than owning a car for most people.

USAID FUNDED TERRORISM AND ARMED MILITANTS
Taxpayer money sent through USAID ended up in the hands of armed groups and terrorists in multiple regions.
Documented cases include:
•  Hamas in Gaza — USAID’s own Inspector General found widespread diversion of aid to Hamas terrorists.
•  Syria — Funds went to opposition groups, some with ties to extremist factions involved in killing civilians (including Christians).
•  Parts of Africa — Development money reached militant organizations instead of the intended humanitarian purposes.
This wasn’t a few isolated mistakes. It was a pattern of poor oversight in an agency spending tens of billions of dollars with almost no real accountability.

USAID WAS A MASSIVE FRAUD OPERATION — AND THE PROOF IS IN THE COURT RECORDS

For years, USAID operated with almost zero real accountability while spending tens of billions of taxpayer dollars.

The most damning evidence:
•  In June 2025, a USAID contracting officer and three corporate executives pleaded guilty to a decade-long bribery scheme involving over $550 million in contracts. The official received at least $14 million in bribes.
•  Wasteful and ideological spending included taxpayer-funded drag workshops in Ecuador, transgender operas in Colombia, and DEI comics in Peru.
•  USAID was also used to fund media outlets, train journalists, and influence elections in foreign countries — far beyond traditional humanitarian aid.
